ORDINANCE NO. 5389
(of Clark County, Nevada)
AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND TITLE 3 OF THE CLARK COUNTY CODE BY
AMENDING CHAPTER 3.68 TO MODIFY THE MAKE-UP OF THE
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE (CDAC) AND
ALL PROVISIONS RELATED THERETO; AND PROVIDING FOR OTHER
MATTERS PROVIDED HEREIN.
THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF THE COUNTY OF CLARK,
STATE OF NEVADA, DOES HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
Section 1. Title 3, Chapter 3.68, of the Clark County Code is hereby amended as follows:
3.68.010 Created — General provisions.
There is created the community development advisory committee. The membership of the
committee shall consist of one £1) representative from each city that participates with Clark
County in an urban county consortium defined by 24 CFR 92.101, or successor provisions;
and one (1) representative from each county commission district on e r e pr e s e ntativ e from

citiz e ns advisory council; — and fourt ee n at larg e m e mb e rs . The board of county
commissioners shall designate the chair and vice chair of the committee.
3.68.030 Members generally.
The members of the committee representing each city shall be appointed by the governing
body of the respective cities , recognized by the board of county commissioners, and shall
be non-voting members. The seven (7) at-large members of the committee shall be

3.68.0 4 0 Alt e rnat e m e mb e r s .

3.68.070 Quorum and rules for transaction of business.
On e third Four (4) of the appointed voting members of the committee shall constitute a
quorum for the transaction of business. The committee may adopt rules for the transaction
of its business, not inconsistent with applicable federal, state or local laws.
Section 2. All ordinances, parts of ordinances, chapters, sections, subsections, clauses,
phrases or sentences contained in the Clark County Code in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.

the publication thereof by title only, together with the names of the County Commissioners voting
for or against its passage, in a newspaper published in and having a general circulation in Clark
County, Nevada, at least once a week for a period of two (2) weeks.

3.68.040 Alternate members.
One alternate member may be appointed, or nominated, for each member ofthe committee;
and the alternate member may only act in the absence ofthe member for whom he or she
was appointed as an alternate.

One third Four (4) of the appointed voting members of the committee shall constitute a

the publication thereof by title only, together with the names ofthe County Commissioners voting

County, Nevada, at least once a week for a period oftwo (2) weeks.
